purpose: Replace the procedural Spitter placeholder with one readable ranged-drone master while retaining single-frame scope.
camera: fixed orthographic top-down three-quarter camera pitched down approximately 45 degrees
facing: single right-facing master; flip horizontally when the player is to the left
identity: light tripod drone with twin green fluid canisters, cyan sensor, and short acid nozzle
generation_model: imagegen built-in with local chroma-key removal and deterministic 128px packing
